summary: Frontend E2E verified end-to-end for Gachard demo-account real on-chain minting flow. All 6 requested checks PASSED: (1) /login shows 'Demo Account' button + Google OAuth section (Google not configured message visible as expected), (2) clicking Demo Account calls POST /api/auth/demo (200) and logs in with sequential @DemoN username (observed @Demo5 then @Demo7 on subsequent clicks — increments), (3) /profile shows @DemoN handle + Credit Balance 10,000 + profile-rarity-bar present, NO 0x wallet address anywhere, (4) /packs shows 'Your Balance: 10,000 Credit'; Buy & Open triggered real on-chain mint (POST /api/mint returned 200 with 5 cards in ~8s), balance decreased to 9,500, Open Pack CTA revealed 5 card-reveal-0..4 elements (Common/Common/Common/Rare/Legendary), NO wallet visible during flow, (5) /admin (HTTP Basic admin/gachard123) Users table lists demo users with 0x wallet addresses (15 wallets total) and Transactions tab shows 'mint' entries with real BNB testnet txHash links to testnet.bscscan.com (3 real mined txs observed), (6) Regression: /play-trade open-pack-cta still works, produces card-reveal-0..4 + reveal-view-collection + pack-demo-reset test-ids. Wallet/blockchain data is correctly Admin-only.
critical_code_review_comments: PackReveal flow requires an extra manual 'Open Pack' click after the mint API returns. That is user-friendly but the review request phrasing implied Buy & Open would directly reveal — worth confirming this two-step UX is intentional (Buy & Open → Pack Ready → Open Pack → card-reveal-*).
Admin page presents wallet + txHash in plain text tables; consider truncated display + copy-to-clipboard for better UX (cosmetic, not a bug).
test_credentials: Demo Account button (no manual auth). Admin: admin / gachard123 via HTTP Basic.
seed_data_creation: Created 2-3 real @DemoN accounts on BNB testnet during test (each triggers real custodial wallet). 1 real on-chain pack mint executed to conserve gas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows verified. If retesting, keep real on-chain mints minimal (1-2 max). Observed BSC testnet tx hashes in admin: 0xfb814c86..., 0xb7214a0b..., 0xb47a6f00... — these can be reconfirmed on testnet.bscscan.com. To capture the POST /api/auth/demo JSON body reliably in playwright, read the JSON inside the response handler synchronously; grabbing later via resp.json() sometimes fails because the response body is discarded after navigation. Use domcontentloaded (not networkidle) when navigating between pages — this site keeps long-lived connections that never idle.
